entities.description: event extraction is a core task in natural language processing that involves identifying event triggers and associated arguments from unstructured text
natural language processing is a field of study within artificial intelligence focused on the interaction between computers and human language
llm based synergistic enhancement framework is a proposed model that features a closed loop mechanism of generation annotation validation scoring for data augmentation
generation annotation validation scoring is a closed loop mechanism used in the proposed framework for data augmentation and quality control
data augmentation is a process used to alleviate data sparsity in event extraction by generating additional training data
synonym substitution is a data augmentation method that replaces words with their synonyms to generate variations of the original text
back translation is a data augmentation method that translates text to another language and then back to the original to create variations
semantic role substitution is a multi strategy rewriting method used in the generation module to transcend word level augmentation limitations
event structure restructuring is a multi strategy rewriting method used in the generation module to transcend word level augmentation limitations
constrained generation is a method used in the generation module to ensure semantic consistency during data augmentation
trigger argument logical verification is a method used in the validation module to eliminate structural bias in generated data
event template matching is a method used in the validation module to eliminate structural bias in generated data
information integrity is a criterion used in the scoring module to filter data based on its accuracy and completeness
semantic consistency is a criterion used in the scoring module to filter data based on its adherence to the original meaning
